source_title: What to Do With 'Thief's Manual' in Phantom Blade Zero
source_excerpt:
The Thief Manual is a story item in Phantom Blade Zero tied to the 'Leave None Alive' quest that players receive after defeating all enemies in the Crimson Forest's Thieves' Den. Everyone at the camp transforms into Maskwalkers, especially once players progress to the third region, the Village of Lu. Similar to all story items, you'll need to figure out what to actually do with the Thief's Manual, and that's exactly what this guide will explain.
What Should You Do With the "Thief's Manual" in Phantom Blade Zero?
First, players will need to get the Thief's Manual in Phantom Blade Zero by visiting the Thieves' Camp in the Crimson Forest region. Make sure to do this after you complete the Crimson Forest region and reach the Village of Lu region.
Once you arrive at the camp, you'll notice several friendly NPCs have turned hostile and into mindless Maskwalkers. You'll need to defeat them all, but defeating one particular enemy standing in front of Quick Hang Zhang's hideout will give you the Thief's Manual story item.
Once you have the Thief's Manual in Phantom Blade Zero , return to the Village of Lu and progress through the region normally. After you defeat the first master boss to open up the well, you'll eventually end up in the western area of the village .
Keep following the critical path until a cutscene where players and Soul talk to an injured thief lying next to the entrance to the smuggler's tunnel leading into Pangzhen.
After the thief finishes his conversation about the girl, you'll need to select the dialog "Any other requests?"
This will prompt the Thief to request Soul to check up on his brothers at the Thieves' Camp in Crimson Forest . But since you've already visited the area and retrieved the Thief's Manual, the "Leave None Alive" quest will finish right away.
After Soul hands over the Thief's Manual to the injured thief, he'll hand over the Arrowward accessory . It's a useful accessory for players like me who're really annoyed when ranged enemies take half an HP bar off Soul when you're engaged with another enemy. It will reduce ranged damage and Sha-Chi depletion by 20% , which can be increased if you use a Tainted Crystal Shard to polish (upgrade) it.
